# Standards and checks

Which component follows which standard, and when it was last checked against it. Edit [`standards.toml`](standards.toml) and run `python3 tools/standards.py`; `tests/run_tests.sh` fails when this page is not current.

A **check** means the standard's text was read next to the code. *Basis* is what the code was written or verified against when it was written; **tbd** means no check is recorded yet.
